title: V5: seal immediately when cluster gate OK (cut ACK→seal lag)
brief: Debug (docs/debug/20260605): residual ~10% is pre_timeout gate wait + poll after attest ready, not steady timeout; ACK→seal p50 15ms but tails to ~800ms while grid scheduler defers commit. Fix: when run_cluster_gate is true after deadline (active slot opened), seal in the same loop iteration—no extra poll_pause, no wait for next grid tick. Owner invariant: seal MUST NOT run before should_attempt_seal(next_seal_time_ms); ahead window remains propose-only (no early seal for metrics). Target: ack_to_seal p50 < 100ms, T_100 ~110–130s, slots_struck < 15% steady.

owner_invariants: No seal before now_ms >= next_seal_time_ms (variant C grid)
seal_ahead_ms path: wire propose only, never chain.seal in ahead window
seal-on-gate-ready applies only after deadline branch entered (begin_slot active)
design.hypothesis: Gate OK but loop sleeps poll_pause or re-enters slot logic before seal
non_goals: Early seal on ACK before grid deadline

acceptance_criteria: Invariant test/doc: no chain.seal when now_ms < next_seal_time_ms even if gate would pass
Unit/integration: after deadline, gate OK → seal same iteration without poll_pause before seal
CY 5min soak: ACK→Seal p50 < 200ms on paired peer+proposer logs
No regression: preflight waiting_for_attester; height-dedup wait/to/strike; interval strike ≤1 per slot/height
